div.h1: UAE Corporate Tax in Odoo: Report, Closing Entry and Setup
div.p: Prepare your UAE Corporate Tax figures from the same Odoo ledger that holds your VAT.

div.h2: Who needs to think about UAE Corporate Tax
div.p: UAE Corporate Tax is set by Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022. It applies to financial years that start on or after 1 June 2023. Companies register and file through the Federal Tax Authority portal, EmaraTax. Most finance teams now need a Corporate Tax figure at every year end, and not only a VAT return for each period.

This page is general information and not tax advice. Your tax agent confirms your company position, including whether you are in scope, which reliefs apply and how a free zone company or a group is treated. Odoo then holds the numbers your agent works from.

div.h2: The headline rules at a glance
div.p: These are the main points finance managers ask about first.

ul.li: Rate: 0% on taxable income up to AED 375,000 and 9% on taxable income above that amount.
Start date: financial years starting on or after 1 June 2023.
Filing: registration and the return go through EmaraTax. The return is due within 9 months of the end of the tax period.
Small Business Relief: resident persons with revenue of AED 3 million or less can elect for it, for tax periods ending on or before 31 December 2026.
Qualifying Free Zone Persons: they can get 0% on qualifying income.
Records: keep them for 7 years.

div.p: Confirm each point with your tax agent before you rely on it. Your facts decide how the rules apply to your company.

div.h2: What the Corporate Tax Report in Odoo 18 shows
div.p: Odoo 18 Enterprise includes a UAE Corporate Tax Report. It reads the ledger entries for the period and lays out the calculation line by line.

ul.li: Income: what the company earned in the period.
Less cost of revenue: the direct cost of earning that income.
Less expenses: the operating expenses of the period.
Gross profit: income less cost of revenue.
Net income: the profit after expenses.
Exempt income: income that you treat as exempt.
Disallowed portion of expenses: the part of expenses that is not deductible.
Tax-exempt amount: the amount of income that is not taxed.
Tax percentage: the rate applied to the taxable amount.
Corporate Tax amount: the tax due for the period.

div.p: The figures come from the same ledger as your other financial reports, so finance does not rebuild them in a spreadsheet at year end.
When the period is final, you create a CIT Closing journal entry from the report. The entry uses the Corporate Tax liability accounts that you set in the Corporate Tax settings.
The result is an entry for the period in your books, so your auditors and your tax agent see the tax in the ledger and not only in a separate file.

div.h2: UAE Corporate Tax in Odoo: your questions answered

details.summary: Does Odoo calculate corporate tax automatically?
details.p: Odoo 18 Enterprise calculates the lines of the Corporate Tax Report from your ledger, from net income to the tax amount. The result is only as good as the setup, so the accounts must be mapped correctly and your tax agent should review the figures. The return itself is submitted on the EmaraTax portal.

details.summary: What is Small Business Relief and can we use it?
details.p: Resident persons with revenue of AED 3 million or less can elect for Small Business Relief, for tax periods ending on or before 31 December 2026. Whether your company qualifies and whether to elect is a decision for you and your tax agent. Odoo holds the revenue figures you both need to check.

details.summary: How does Odoo handle free zone companies?
details.p: Qualifying Free Zone Persons can get 0% on qualifying income. Which of your income counts as qualifying is for your tax agent to confirm. In Odoo we can use separate income accounts for the different kinds of income, so the figures your agent needs are easy to find.

details.summary: Can Odoo handle VAT and Corporate Tax together?
details.p: Yes. The UAE localisation covers VAT at 5% and the VAT return report, and the Corporate Tax Report reads from the same ledger. Both taxes share one chart of accounts, so you post a transaction once.

details.summary: We already use Odoo. Can we add Corporate Tax?
details.p: Yes, if you run Odoo Enterprise. We check your version, your chart of accounts and your journals first. Then we map the accounts, configure the liability accounts and the tax periods, and train your team on the report and the closing entry.

details.summary: Do we need Enterprise or is Community enough for this report?
details.p: The Corporate Tax Report is part of Odoo 18 Enterprise. Community does not include it. Community can still record your transactions, but you would need Enterprise for the report and the CIT closing entry created from it.
